headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest or declining results.
summary: Coforge led revenue growth with a 53.6% YoY increase and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech delivered double‑digit profit growth on solid AI revenue. Infosys and Wipro showed the weakest top‑line momentum, with revenue growth under 2% and profit pressure respectively. Overall, AI services contributed positively but the sector remains mixed.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech maintained an 18.2% operating margin.

themes.title: Dividend and shareholder returns
themes.detail: Most companies announced or increased interim dividends, reflecting cash generation despite mixed earnings growth.
